name: WePlayDroneSwarms
title: WePlay: Laser-Equipped Drone Swarms
author: afewvowels
description: Swarms of laser drones that clear biter nests far beyond your walls. Drones launch one at a time and circle the launchpad until the swarm is ready, then fly out together, whirl around the nests and pulse-laser everything in sight. An alternative to artillery.
